Part I — Knowledge Base (English)
Bhaiya's Teachings — Knowledge Base (Session 53, English)
The Water Science of Chakras: Infections, the Hunger -Thirst Siddhi, and Why Even Kundalini Awakening Can Backfir e

Sour ce: a Mool T atva live session opening with practical guidance for newcomers and a r ecap on the long-term effects of drishti, befor e moving into an extended teaching on a lesser -known vidya: the claim that every chakra in the body is actually built fr om a single element — water (jal tatva) — and the practical consequences that follow fr om this, including the mechanics of infection, the hunger/thirst siddhi, and why externally-granted kundalini awakening can leave a person chr onically stuck.
1. Guidance for Newcomers

Bhaiya opens with practical instructions for anyone attending for the first time: watch the Mool Tatva introduction video, and commit to a minimum of 15 to 20 lakh japa alongside personal practice. Only once this baseline is reached does Ashaeiynn send supporting shaktis that produce a genuinely positive ef fect on the practitioner .
2. The Long-T erm Effect of Drishti (3 Years In)

Responding to a sister's question about drishti's long-term ef fect, Bhaiya describes what happens roughly three years into sustained practice: an invisible power begins accompanying the practitioner at every step, of fering guidance on right and wrong, showing the way forward, and revealing both this world and the subtle world simultaneously . Combined with one's own guru relationship and one's own mantra shakti, a practitioner at this stage stands "on the ver ge of becoming a king" — manifestation power increases so dramatically that whatever is sincerely wished for eventually happens, without exception (though not necessarily immediately).
3. Why "Eventually" and Not "Instantly"

Per this teaching, if what you ask for does not conflict with your planetary (graha) placements, it is granted right away . If it does conflict, it is granted once the relevant planetary period passes. If your mantra shakti is powerful enough to supply the required ener gy quickly , the timeline can be sped up significantly .
4. The Danger of Asking for What Isn't Yours

A crucial caution: if you ask for and r eceive something that was never destined for you (i.e., outside your own planetary allotment), the entire universe effectively turns against you — because whatever was originally meant for someone else has, in ef fect, been taken from them, and that imbalance invites retaliation. Practitioners are advised to keep their own ener gy reserves stocked specifically so they can "rebound" such consequences. This is precisely why drishti matters.
5. Drishti as a "Necessary Evil"

Bhaiya describes drishti (spiritual vision) as a necessary evil : necessary , because without it a person would wander confused between dif ferent babas, pandits, and pir -fakirs seeking answers; evil, because it makes a person "more than conscious" — hyper -aware and

required to attend to small details most people never notice. Receiving drishti also comes with real responsibility , carrying both a positive and a negative side — and notably , whether or not a committed practitioner (around two years in) actually receives it is not entirely within their own contr ol.
6. Intr oducing a New Vidya: The Water Science Behind "Infection"

Bhaiya introduces the day's core teaching: a vidya connected to the jal tatva (water element), built from 1 1 anu (particles) and 21 mahanu (gr eat-particles) — of fered as the underlying esoteric mechanism behind what is popularly called "infection."
7. Standard Biology , Reframed

Infection, in ordinary biological terms, occurs when a foreign particle enters the body and the immune system (white blood cells) mounts a resistance, producing inflammation. This teaching accepts this basic biological picture as accurate, then layers a subtle-world explanation beneath it.
8. The "Dvait Sangam" and the Four Lokas

Between the 1 1 anu and 21 mahanu exists a significant confluence called the "dvait sangam" (dualistic confluence). This is connected to four lokas — importantly , not Earth, sky , and the underworld in the traditional sense, but four distinct horizontal-and-vertical layers existing in the air , between the ground and the sky , centered at the Earth's core.
9. The Central Claim: Every Chakra Is Made of the Same Element — Water

Contrary to the popular belief that dif ferent chakras correspond to dif ferent elements (fire, earth, air , etc.) and are recognized by their dif fering colors, this teaching states plainly that every chakra is built fr om the same single element: water (jal tatva). Only the colors dif fer — a function of dif fering light frequencies falling on the same underlying water -based structure, not dif fering underlying elements.
10. How Chakras Actually Work, Mechanically

Water molecules — described using a chemistry analogy of ordinary H2O versus a much "heavier ," highly condensed form — form dif ferent structures within dif ferent chakras. When ener gy (light) falls on these structures, each reflects a dif ferent colored beam depending on its particular molecular arrangement. The apparent "elemental" identity often attributed to a given chakra (fire chakra, earth chakra, etc.) is, per this teaching, really just a dif ferently-colored light ef fect on the same underlying water medium.
1 1. Testing the Claim: Does Fir e or Fasting Deplete a Chakra's Water?

Bhaiya walks the sangat through a Socratic test: if sitting near a hawan fire, or going without water for extended periods, actually depleted a chakra's water content, chakras should visibly "run out" and shut down. But the body continuously produces water even without external intake, and drinking water afterward restores what evaporated as sweat — water never truly disappears; it only converts/transforms (evaporating and rising), which is why chakras don't stay fixed in place, contrary to popular belief.
12. What Actually Happens: Chakras Displace Upward Under Heat

When tapo-agni (inner fire) increases in the body , the water within a chakra evaporates and rises; wherever it eventually cools and recondenses into a stable shape, a new chakra effectively forms at that higher point. This displacement mechanism is what people describe when they speak of kundalini ener gy "rising" toward the sahasrara (crown) — it is water rising via fir e, not fire itself ascending. Fire does not travel upward; it only intensifies where it is, and it is specifically the water that gets carried upward by it.
13. Why Externally-Granted Kundalini Awakening Can Backfir e

A crucial practical consequence: once someone's chakra/kundalini ener gy has been artificially raised to a higher level — for instance, through shaktipat from a guru claiming "your ener gy has reached the sahasrara" — the practitioner now needs a proportionally gr eater amount of their own inner agni (fir e) to actually access or use that elevated position. Most people cannot generate anywhere near that much fire on their own. This mismatch, not any flaw in the blessing itself, is why some people who receive externally-granted "awakening" become chronically stuck in negativity afterward — their vayu-shaped water structures have been pushed to a level their own fire cannot sustain, leaving the levels below under -defended.
14. A Genuinely Unusual Vidya: Conquering Hunger and Thirst

Using this same 1 1-anu/21-mahanu subtle-world science, a practitioner who learns to "sirodhaari" (bind/hold at the crown) the water element can attain a specific siddhi: freedom fr om hunger and thirst.
15. The Mechanism Behind This Siddhi

This siddhi requires establishing two distinct for ces simultaneously : one placed above the body that cools the chakra system, and one placed below that heats it. As a result, ener gy that enters warm at the base becomes cool by the time it reaches the top, staying selfcontained within the body rather than escaping outward. Per this teaching, most people lose the majority of their bodily energy precisely because it "leaks" outward thr ough their own chakras — comparable to why Reiki practitioners are specifically taught to always deliberately close/deactivate an ener gy channel after use, or risk complications.
16. Building the Two For ces Yourself

Initial training for this siddhi involves deliberately practicing physical extremes — sitting near fire during summer heat, or venturing into extreme cold during winter . Over time, the twin cooling-and-heating forces (initially given by a guru) must be self-generated and eventually mer ged by the practitioner themselves, at which point the dedicated sadhna for this siddhi can properly begin.
17. An Important Caveat About This Siddhi

Even after conquering literal hunger and thirst, a person retains ordinary taste-craving ("jeevha ka laalach") — meaning someone with this siddhi may still choose to eat purely out of desire for taste, even without any biological need to do so.
18. Practical Application: Contr olling Infections Through the Chakras

Since every chakra is built from the same jal tatva, this teaching states that a person can use this same water -based chakra mechanism to reduce, eliminate, incr ease, or worsen infections anywhere in the body . This is of fered as the explanation for why minor , popularly-worshipped "kalyug" deities (gram devta, bhomiya ji, Ramdev ji, and similar local figures) are so specifically ef fective at resolving boils, rashes, itches, and other minor infections with nothing more than a token of fering — they specialize pr ecisely in this anu/mahanu, jal-tatva-based infection mechanism.
19. The Three-Element Formula for Contr olling Your Own Chakras

Per this teaching, controlling one's own chakra system (for infection, ener gy , or health generally) requires three elements working together: jal (water) — which is simply the practitioner's own body , requiring no separate action; vayu (air) — which gives water its shape, generated through mantra jaap; and agni (fir e) — which lifts and delivers the water/ener gy upward, generated primarily through hawan.
20. When a Bigger Power Artificially Elevates a Smaller Person's Energy

Sometimes a much more powerful entity artificially pushes a devotee's chakra ener gy far beyond what the devotee's own fire could reach unaided — illustrated hypothetically as someone whose own fire can only reach a "10th dimension" having their chakra ener gy externally pushed all the way to a "100th dimension." This creates an unbridgeable ener gy gap invisible to ordinary diagnostic

methods; an aura-scanner examining such a person may wrongly conclude their "prarthana shakti" (prayer power) has failed or is "lol" (inef fective), when the real issue is simply a mismatch between an externally-elevated water position and an insuf ficient personal fire capacity to draw upon it.
21. When the Same Mechanism Is a Positive, Guaranteed Push

The same mechanism can work positively: a rishi or saint's own subtle power may deliberately melt/push a sincere devotee's chakra ener gy to a much higher dimension as a guaranteed blessing — ef fectively saying, "raise your own fire, and whatever you then ask for is guaranteed to come from that elevated level," because the saint has already reserved/left a portion of their own chakra ener gy at that height on the devotee's behalf.
22. Why Some Blessed Devotees Feel Nothing — and Why Saints Get Blamed Unfairly

This same mismatch explains why some people who receive a major saint's blessing (kundalini raised to a high dimension) report that the promised results never materialize: their own body's agni simply isn't strong enough to draw on the elevated placement. Onlookers often unfairly conclude the saint is a fraud ("dhongi") — when, per this teaching, neither the saint nor the backing shakti did anything wrong; the practitioner's own fire capacity is the missing piece.
23. The Fix: Build Your Own Agni

Per this teaching, three practices build one's own inner fire: mantra jaap , tapasya/vrat (fasting — deliberately reducing external "intake" so internal heat builds naturally), and hawan (the fastest, most accessible route to rapidly increasing one's agni tatva). Bhaiya cites Bhagwan Shiva's own teaching that "the fruit of a thousand yagnas lies in a single japa of a true tapasvi" — true, but conditional on maintaining unbroken brahmacharya and sustained tapasya; absent that level of personal austerity , hawan remains the most practically accessible source of agni for most people.
24. Why Chakras Are Effectively Infinite in Number

Because chakras are, per this teaching, simply repeated vayu-formed shapes around rising water rather than a fixed set of distinct or gans, they cannot be meaningfully counted — new chakras keep forming higher and higher as one's agni increases, contradicting the popular idea of a fixed, countable number of chakras (commonly cited as seven).
25. Negative Energy Can Travel the Same Route

This teaching confirms that negative ener gy can travel into the body via the same vayu-shaped chakra structures, just as positive ener gy does — with a further , dedicated 40-minute "Asha Pathshala" session on vayu tatva referenced as a deeper resource on this specific point.
26. Grahas Work Through a Separate Mechanism, Not Through "Eating" Chakras

Planetary influences (grahas) are explicitly distinguished from the chakra/jal-tatva mechanism: a weak Mangal (Mars), for instance, causes stomach pain, injuries, anger , and blood-related issues concentrated in the lower body , through its own separate mechanism — grahas do not "eat" chakras directly .
27. Diagnosing Where the Real Pr oblem Lies

If an aura-scan shows trouble specifically in the lower chakras while the upper ones read fine, per this teaching the issue is not a water (jal) deficiency — since the same water is rising through both regions — but specifically a vayu (air/shape) deficiency localized to that region. The remedy in such cases is to strengthen one's vayu tatva specifically , through mantra jaap, ajapa jaap, kapalbhati, and anulom-vilom breathing practices.
28. Mantra Doots and Their Role in This Mechanism

Mantra doots (mantra-messengers) play a specific role: ensuring that a practitioner's rising water properly continues ascending without getting stuck at any particular chakra — they can even construct an entirely new chakra where none previously existed, specifically to keep the water moving upward. Per this teaching, "mantra doots can do anything" within this particular function.
29. Why Mantra Jaap Alone Naturally Balances All Chakras

Because vayu (generated by mantra jaap) is what gives water its shape at every chakra, consistent mantra jaap naturally supplies the vayu needed to properly move one's water upward throughout the entire chakra system — explaining why jaap alone is often described as suf ficient to balance all chakras.
30. Why Advanced Practitioners' Experiences Stay Private

Responding to a question about what long-term, advanced-level sadhaks within Ashaeiynn actually experience, Bhaiya explains that such experiences are deliberately kept confidential and unnamed — naming a practitioner or publicizing their specific siddhi risks disrupting ("bhang") their ongoing sadhna. Direct personal experience within the community is presented as the appropriate way to learn this, rather than relying on public testimonials or demonstrations.
31. Two Recent, Deliberately Unpublicized Examples

Without naming anyone, Bhaiya shares two recent examples: one practitioner who can now see through multiple walls and buildings, and even internally within the human body (veins, bones); and another who has been engaged in a dedicated Agni Tatva sadhna for roughly two years. Both are of fered as proof that such abilities genuinely develop within the community — but Ashaeiynn deliberately avoids publicizing or "proving" them externally , both to protect practitioners from outside negativity , skepticism, or jealousy , and because these powers are not meant for public demonstration — genuine experience must be sought firsthand by joining the community , not through video proof.
32. A Pointed Contrast, Without Naming Names

Bhaiya explicitly declines to name or directly critique other well-known dhams that issue formal printed "proof" documents ("parcha") of blessings or results, stating plainly that he does not wish to name them — a deliberate contrast with Ashaeiynn's own approach of keeping genuine experiences private rather than externally documented or publicized.
QUICK RULES SUMMARY

New practitioners should complete a minimum of 15-20 lakh japa before Ashaeiynn's supporting shaktis are sent to produce a genuinely positive ef fect. Around thr ee years into sustained practice , an invisible guiding power begins accompanying a practitioner at every step, and manifestation power increases dramatically — though "eventually" (governed by one's own grahas), not necessarily instantly . Asking for something outside your own planetary allotment invites universal pushback — keep your own ener gy reserves stocked to rebound the consequences; this is precisely why drishti matters. Drishti is a "necessary evil" — necessary to avoid confusion and wandering, but demanding constant hyper -awareness and real responsibility; receiving it is not entirely within one's own control. Every chakra, contrary to popular belief, is built from the same single element: water (jal tatva) — only the colors dif fer, based on dif fering light frequencies on the same underlying structure. Chakras ar e not fixed in place — under rising inner fire (tapo-agni), water evaporates and re-condenses higher up, forming new chakras; this is the real mechanism behind "rising" kundalini ener gy .

Externally-granted kundalini awakening (shaktipat) can backfir e if the practitioner's own fire (agni) cannot reach the elevated chakra position it creates — leaving lower levels under -defended and the person chronically stuck in negativity . The hunger/thirst siddhi r equires two simultaneous for ces — a cooling force above, a heating force below — so ener gy stays self-contained in the body instead of leaking outward, the same reason Reiki practitioners are taught to always "close" an ener gy channel after use. Minor/"kalyug" deities specialize in the jal-tatva infection mechanism — this is why a token of fering to a local devta can resolve boils, rashes, and minor infections ef fectively . Contr olling one's own chakra system r equires three elements: jal (the body itself), vayu (shape, from mantra jaap), and agni (lift/delivery , from hawan). A weak planet's effects concentrate in specific chakras via a separate mechanism , not by consuming chakra water directly — diagnosing localized (e.g., lower -body) chakra trouble points to a vayu deficiency , not a jal deficiency , and is remedied through mantra jaap, ajapa jaap, kapalbhati, and anulom-vilom. Advanced practitioners' specific experiences ar e deliberately kept private and unpublicized — to protect their ongoing sadhna, not because such abilities don't exist. Bot Response Guidelines (Session 53 additions)

Keep the "all chakras are made of water , only colors dif fer" claim precisely scoped to this teaching's own framework — present it as this session's specific teaching, not a claim about mainstream chakra theory broadly . Preserve the fire/water displacement mechanism accurately: fire does not rise, it intensifies; water rises via fire and recondenses into new chakras higher up. Do not reverse this causality . When discussing why externally-granted kundalini awakening or shaktipat can backfire, keep the explanation focused on the agni/water mismatch this teaching describes — avoid implying such practices are inherently wrong or fraudulent. When explaining why some blessed devotees don't feel results, keep the framing neutral and non-accusatory toward saints/gurus — the mismatch is described as the practitioner's own insuf ficient agni, not the saint's failure. Keep grahas (planetary influence) and the chakra/jal-tatva mechanism explicitly distinct, per this teaching's own clarification — do not conflate the two mechanisms. Do not name or speculate about the specific advanced practitioners or the other named/unnamed dhams referenced obliquely in this session — this teaching itself deliberately withholds those names.
